info.title: diskusage - interactive disk browser and file inventory exporter
info.description: Fast interactive disk usage browser and file inventory exporter for .NET.

options.name: --follow-links
options.description: Follow symbolic links/reparse points (cycles are detected)

options.name: --threads
options.description: Parallel directory workers (default: up to 4; use 1 for HDDs)

options.name: --format
options.description: parquet, csv, tsv, or shorthand such as csv.br, tsv.gz, csv.zip

options.name: --compression
options.description: none, br, gz, or zip (CSV/TSV only)

options.name: --stdout
options.description:
Write the export to stdout; --output - is equivalent
File filters (export and upload):

options.name: --extensions
options.description:
Comma-separated final extensions, e.g. txt,.csv,*.log; case-insensitive
Repeat to add extensions; use "<none>" for extensionless files

options.name: --top
options.description:
Largest N matching files, descending size; ties by ordinal full path
Scans all eligible files and retains at most N records
Sizes                  Bytes by default; KB/MB/GB/TB decimal; KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB binary

options.name: --access-key
options.description: Access key; standard AWS credential sources work when omitted

options.name: --session-token
options.description:
Optional temporary credential token
--virtual-hosted-style Disable path-style bucket addressing
